command: async (page) => { const response=page.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().endsWith("/api/actions/advance") && r.request().method()==="POST",{timeout:120000}); await page.getByRole("button",{name:"Advance Week ▸",exact:true}).click(); const r=await response; return {url:r.url(),status:r.status(),body:await r.text(),request:r.request().postData()}; }
